overall.verdict: A visually premium, honest wallet whose signed-receipt and 'enforceable right now' moments are genuinely best-in-class trust design, undermined by recurring protocol jargon (entity, lane, capacity, frames, board), duplicated hard-to-differentiate legend colors, and stacked-toast/disabled-CTA failures on the cross-network swap path. Most screens are shippable; the cross-network and receive/lend flows need language and state-machine fixes before a mainstream user finishes their task unaided.
priority_fixes: Global copy pass replacing entity/lane/capacity/frames/board with plain payment language (Receive, Lend, Move, Ownership screens); biggest single satisfaction lift across Maya/Sofia/Fatima
Fix cross-network swap step flow (05b): explicit step list, never overlay toasts on CTA, always state why a button is disabled — unblocks Fatima
Recolor the money-state palette (secured vs promised vs owed vs in-flight) with distinct hues matched across home, sovereignty, account and all mini-bars — unblocks Tomasz/Ravi/Marcus glance reads
Disabled-state reasons everywhere (Lend 'Offer to the pool', cross-swap CTA) and add amount/rate previews on lending
Always-visible 'what happens' summary pinned above the primary button on Pay/Move, and stake the primary CTA visually (Done vs export actions on receipt)
